title: Religious Symbols: Copy & Paste Faith & Spiritual Symbols
meta_description: Browse and copy religious, spiritual, and faith-related Unicode symbols from major world traditions. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
hero_tagline: A reference collection of religious, spiritual, and faith-related Unicode symbols from major world traditions. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
intro: This library contains symbols from Christianity, Islam, Judaism, Hinduism, Buddhism, and other world traditions, along with universal spiritual and peace symbols. Organized by faith tradition and category.

sections.label: Christian
sections.h2: God Is Greater Than the Highs and Lows Symbol
sections.intro: A modern faith shorthand for tattoos, shirts and bios that reads "God is greater than the highs and lows": G for God, > for greater than, then a peak (^ or ∧) for the highs and a valley (v or ∨) for the lows. All three forms say the same thing; G>^v is plain keyboard text, so it shows on every device.
